name: Delivery Nutty Almond Cookies
ingredients_raw: Oats - Flour & Flakes (30%), Wheat Flour, Sweetener (INS 965(i), INS 960), Bakery Shortening (Vegetable fat - Palm /Palmolein oil and palm kernel oil based), Sweet Almond Bits (5%), Butter, Milk Solids (Skimmed Milk Powder), Fructo oligosaccharides (3%), Raising agents (INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii)), Salt, Emulsifiers (INS 322(i), INS 472e). CONTAINS ADDED NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL (MILK) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES.
